topic: API test fails TLS validation against internal service
environment: HTTPS API test from a private location
symptom_pattern: An HTTPS API test from a private location fails with a certificate error ('unable to verify the first certificate') while browsers in the office show the site as secure.
root_cause: The service uses a certificate from an internal CA that is trusted on corporate laptops but not by the worker. The test needs the CA trusted on the worker or 'accept self-signed certificates' enabled as a stop-gap.
resolution_path: Read the TLS error in results
Trust the internal root CA in the worker (or enable accept self-signed) and re-run

qa_pairs.tse_question: Who issued the certificate on that service?
Is the test option to accept self-signed certificates enabled?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: No, we didn't want to weaken security.
